summary: Zhibao Technology Inc. filed Form 6-K disclosing the abrupt July 1, 2026 resignations of its CFO and all independent directors (four in total). The departures were stated as not due to any disagreement. The board immediately appointed Guangtong Ren (current Chief Actuary) as CFO and director, plus three new independent directors. No price, premium, or deal terms apply. This is a forced management reshuffle with no acquisition, tender, or capital event. Watch for potential governance, compliance, or operational disruptions given the simultaneous board overhaul.
